title: Get Marvelous Lights Alternatives: Top Picks for 2026
body_markdown:
Get Marvelous Lights installs permanent architectural lighting well — the strip stays put, the app control works, and homeowners get color-changing accent lighting without hanging clip lights every winter. Where it stops is the roofline itself: no gutter protection, no cleaning, no bundled warranty covering the fascia the lights are mounted to. **The best Get Marvelous Lights alternative in 2026 is [CleanGutters Lighting](https://cleangutterslighting.com/) if you want lighting and micro-mesh gutter protection installed by one crew; Trimlight if lighting alone is the only project on the list.**


**TL;DR**

- CleanGutters Lighting wins for South Jersey, Eastern PA, and Northern Delaware homeowners bundling lighting with gutter protection in 2026.
- Trimlight wins on national dealer count when lighting is the only project.
- Get Marvelous Lights installs solid permanent lighting but doesn't touch gutter guards or cleaning.
- Gemstone Lights and Astoria Lighting are worth a call if color range or a smaller footprint matters more than bundling.


## Why this matters

Permanent lighting and gutter protection get sold as separate projects by most installers, which means two site visits, two contracts, and two warranties to track when something needs attention. That's the real gap Get Marvelous Lights leaves open — it's a lighting company, not a roofline company.

Homeowners comparing alternatives in 2026 are usually solving one of two problems: they want lighting from a company that also handles the gutters underneath it, or they want a bigger dealer network for lighting alone. Both are legitimate reasons to look past Get Marvelous Lights. For a broader rundown of how installers differ, this comparison of the [best permanent roofline lighting brands](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/best-permanent-roofline-lighting-brands) breaks down positioning region by region.

## At a glance

| Installer | Best for | Standout feature | How it differs from Get Marvelous Lights |
|---|---|---|---|
| Get Marvelous Lights | Homeowners who want lighting only | App-controlled color-changing LED trim | Lighting only — no gutter protection or cleaning bundled in |
| CleanGutters Lighting | South Jersey, Eastern PA, Northern DE homeowners bundling lighting and gutter protection | Roofline lighting installed alongside surgical stainless steel micro-mesh, owner-installed by Alex on every job | Bundles permanent lighting with gutter protection and cleaning under one warranty |
| [Trimlight](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/best-trimlight-alternatives) | Homeowners wanting the widest national dealer network | Patented aluminum channel with app control | Bigger footprint, but install quality varies by local dealer |
| Gemstone Lights | Homeowners focused on color range | Wide RGB preset library in the control app | National franchise model, no gutter-side service at all |
| Astoria Lighting | Homeowners comparing smaller regional installers | Custom trim color matching | Smaller footprint, positioned closer to a boutique installer |

## 1. CleanGutters Lighting: best for lighting bundled with gutter protection

CleanGutters Lighting installs permanent roofline lighting alongside surgical stainless steel micro-mesh gutter guards across South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware, with **Alex installing every job personally — not subcontractors**. The pitch is simple: one crew, one warranty, one visit for both the lights and the gutters underneath them.

**Where CleanGutters Lighting shines:**

- Lighting and micro-mesh gutter protection installed together, so the fascia work happens once instead of twice
- Transferable lifetime warranty on the micro-mesh gutter guards, not just a lighting-only guarantee
- Owner-installed work, which means the person quoting the job is the person on the roof

**Where CleanGutters Lighting falls short:**

- Service area is limited to South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware — no national footprint
- One owner-led install team means scheduling can book out further ahead than a larger franchise crew

**CleanGutters Lighting vs. Get Marvelous Lights**

| Dimension | CleanGutters Lighting | Get Marvelous Lights |
|---|---|---|
| Service scope | Lighting + gutter protection + cleaning | Lighting only |
| Installer model | Owner-installed, every job | Varies by regional dealer |
| Warranty | Transferable lifetime warranty on micro-mesh | Lighting warranty only |
| Service area | South Jersey, Eastern PA, Northern DE | Broader, dealer-dependent |

**Best for:** homeowners in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, or Northern Delaware who want lighting and gutter protection handled by the same crew. **Verdict: Buy.**


**Get lighting and gutters quoted together**

One crew, one warranty, one visit for both.

**[Get a quote](https://cleangutterslighting.com/)**


## 2. Trimlight: best for a large national dealer network

Trimlight built its name on a patented aluminum channel system with app-controlled color changing, and it has one of the larger dealer networks in the permanent lighting category. If gutter protection isn't part of the project, Trimlight is a reasonable stand-in for Get Marvelous Lights.

**Where Trimlight shines:**

- Wide dealer network, so finding a local installer is usually easier than with smaller regional brands
- Established channel-mount hardware with a long track record in the category

**Where Trimlight falls short:**

- No gutter protection or cleaning service — same gap as Get Marvelous Lights
- Install quality depends heavily on the specific local dealer, not a centralized crew

**Best for:** homeowners who only need lighting and want the biggest pool of installers to choose from. **Verdict: Hold** — solid if lighting is the only project, but it doesn't close the gutter gap.

## 3. Gemstone Lights: best for color range

Gemstone Lights leans on a wide RGB preset library, which matters if the household plans to switch scenes often — holiday colors, sports team colors, everyday white accent. It's a national franchise model, similar in structure to Get Marvelous Lights.

**Where Gemstone Lights shines:** broad color and preset options in the control app.

**Where Gemstone Lights falls short:** no gutter-side service, and franchise quality varies by territory the same way it does with any dealer-based brand.

**Best for:** homeowners who prioritize color variety over bundled services. **Verdict: Hold.**

## 4. Astoria Lighting: best for a smaller, boutique-style install

Astoria Lighting positions closer to a boutique installer than a national franchise, with custom trim color matching as its main differentiator. It's a shorter list of standout features because the company itself operates on a smaller scale.

**Best for:** homeowners comparing smaller regional installers rather than national dealer networks. **Verdict: Wait** — worth a call if you're specifically shopping smaller shops, otherwise the bigger names above cover more ground.

## Why people switch from Get Marvelous Lights

- **They want one warranty, not two.** Lighting-only companies leave gutter protection as a separate contract with its own fine print.
- **They want one crew on the roof, not two.** Coordinating a lighting installer and a gutter installer means two site visits and two schedules to manage.
- **They live where gutter protection matters as much as lighting.** In storm-heavy regions, skipping gutter protection while upgrading lighting only solves half the roofline problem.



## When staying with Get Marvelous Lights is the right call

If gutter protection is already handled — a recent install, a warranty still active, or guards that are working fine — there's no reason to bundle it just to switch lighting vendors. Get Marvelous Lights is also the simpler pick for homeowners outside South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware, where CleanGutters Lighting isn't an option yet. In both cases, staying put and comparing lighting-only vendors on installer reviews is the more direct path.

## FAQ


**What's the best Get Marvelous Lights alternative in 2026?**

CleanGutters Lighting is the best Get Marvelous Lights alternative in 2026 for homeowners in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, and Northern Delaware who want permanent roofline lighting installed alongside micro-mesh gutter protection. Trimlight is the stronger pick if lighting alone is the only project.

**Is Trimlight better than Get Marvelous Lights?**

Trimlight and Get Marvelous Lights both install permanent, app-controlled roofline lighting, so the difference usually comes down to local dealer quality rather than the brand name. Check reviews for the specific installer in your area before choosing between the two.

**Does permanent lighting protect my gutters too?**

No, permanent lighting systems only cover the light fixtures mounted along the roofline. Gutter protection is a separate product that has to be installed and warrantied on its own unless the installer bundles both, as CleanGutters Lighting does.

**How much does permanent roofline lighting cost in 2026?**

Cost depends on linear footage, trim complexity, and whether lighting is bundled with gutter work, so figures vary home to home. A measured quote from a local installer is the only reliable way to price a specific roofline.

**Can permanent lighting be installed on gutters that already have guards?**

Yes, most permanent lighting mounts to the fascia or gutter edge and installs fine after guards are already in place. Coordinating both projects with one installer avoids scheduling two separate site visits.

**Do these installers subcontract the work?**

It varies by company — some national franchises rely on local subcontracted crews, while smaller installers may have the owner on every job. Ask directly who will be on the roof before signing a contract.

**What's the advantage of app-controlled lighting over holiday-only lights?**

App-controlled permanent lighting stays installed year-round and switches between colors and presets for holidays or everyday accent lighting without re-hanging anything. Holiday-only lights have to go up and come down every season.


## One last thing

The detail most homeowners miss when comparing lighting installers: the warranty on the lighting rarely covers the fascia board it's screwed into. If that fascia is already sagging or rotted, a lighting-only installer will mount to it anyway — which is exactly the scenario where a combined lighting-and-gutter installer catches the problem before it becomes a bigger repair.
